discover.title: Find Star Citizen installs
discover.subtitle: Runs automatically on launch: RSI launcher → filesystem scan. Add more folders by hand below.
discover.none: No install found automatically — add a folder by hand below.

hint.open: Opening the ~157 GB archive — this takes a moment.
hint.datacore: Decompressing the DataCore — this can take a while.

upload.title: Upload
upload.intro: Starting the upload opens your browser for sign-in. After a successful login, the bundle is uploaded automatically.

err.unauthorized: Not signed in or your session is invalid — please reconnect.
err.forbidden: You don't have permission to upload — your account is missing the uploader role.
err.releaseToken: Release token is missing, unknown, or revoked — please update the app.
err.duplicate: A bundle with an equal or newer uploader version already exists for this version and build. Re-upload with a higher uploader version to replace it.
err.ingestFailed: The server couldn't process the bundle — please try again later.
err.invalidBody: Invalid bundle data — please re-run the extraction.
err.serverMisconfigured: The server is misconfigured — please contact the operator.
err.network: Network error — couldn't reach the server. Check your connection and retry.

update.available: Update available: v{{version}} — downloading in background…

session.title: Web connection
session.connectHint: Sign in once — stays connected automatically afterwards.
session.expiredHint: Your saved session has expired — please reconnect.
session.noPersist: Note: no OS keychain — session lasts only until you close the app.

sync.empty: No bundles on the server yet.

telemetry.hint: Sends anonymous crash reports (no personal data) so bugs can be fixed. You can turn this off any time.

skins.partial: ships uploaded (see log for the rest)
skins.hintBuild: First build assembles each ship one by one — can take a few minutes per ship.
skins.hintUpload: Transferring large livery files — this depends on their size.
